description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for Sanguine, a retro survival horror game developed by Ryan Berg. Players will traverse Craven Oaks as sinister forces enter the town. Solve puzzles, scavenge for supplies, and survive before the Bloods consume all that remains. Sanguine is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Sanguine - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Neon Odyssey announcement teaser trailer for this upcoming neon-soaked science fantasy space opera trilogy supplement for D&D 5E from Avantris Entertainment, channeling the nostalgia of the 80’s, 90’s, and early 00’s. A Kickstarter campaign for Neon Odyssey will be available this May 2026.

Neon Odyssey is a 1,400+ page, three-book space opera supplement for D&D 5E. It is built for both longtime players and newcomers who want to blast off to the stars, explore the galaxy, and chart their own cosmic destiny. Drawing inspiration from iconic sci-fi films, retro video games, classic animation, and pop culture nostalgia, Neon Odyssey is built to provide gaming groups everything they need to experience an unforgettable and cinematic space opera with friends, with a plethora of galactic Game Master (GM) tools in a vibrant campaign setting or an astral arsenal of player options to soar among the stars.

#NeonOdyssey #IGN #D&D
title: Neon Odyssey - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for Bulletarium, a first-person retro boomer shooter developed by Anri Ayvazyan. Players will embody a nameless rookie taking on hordes of invading aliens and demons. Take up arms, explore a stylized world, and uncover a deep mystery. Bulletarium is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Bulletarium - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at gameplay and more from Dream Team Supreme in this trailer for the upcoming co-op kaiju battling roguelike deckbuilder game. In Dream Team Supreme, pilot the giant robot Super Supreme and defeat towering monsters in a game inspired by nostalgic Saturday morning cartoons and thrilling comic book battles!

Battle giant refrigerators, bowls of noodles, traffic signs, and octopi colossi before they attack innocent citizens to save the day.

Dream Team Supreme will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
title: Dream Team Supreme - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Ophelia's Paradise, a 2D arena shooter action roguelike developed by Artin Games. Players will ensure the safety of their paradise from sinister shadows seeking to stir some trouble. Take on waves of enemies, make use of an array of weapons, and reserve a top spot on the global leaderboards. Ophelia's Paradise is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Ophelia's Paradise - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at action-packed gameplay from Dark Scrolls in this trailer for the upcoming fantasy-themed action platformer that fuses shmup-style chaos with roguelite progression. In Dark Scrolls, choose from a hefty cast of playable characters - including an axe-throwing warrior, a spell-slinging magician, a knife-hurling thief, or weirder heroes like a cute dog, an alien, or a rat playing a saxophone - and test your skills solo or in local or online co-op. Dark Scrolls will be available on PC and Nintendo Switch on May 28, 2026.
title: Dark Scrolls - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Gangs of Asia is available now on Steam. Watch the Gangs of Asia launch trailer for this multiplayer brawler-strategy hybrid game to see action-packed gameplay, abilities, and more.

Gangs of Asia throws players into vibrant, stylized city districts where the only rule is simple: if everything is under control, you’re probably doing something wrong. Take control of powerful gang leaders, fighting in real time while simultaneously capturing buildings, managing resources, and deploying units across the map.
title: Gangs of Asia - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the RC Frenzy Launch Trailer for The Crew Motorfest, an open-world arcade driving game developed by Ubisoft Ivory Tower. Players will get behind the tiny wheel of an RC car to dodge obstacles, race across tracks, and win big with a small form factor. RC Frenzy is launching on May 6 in The Crew Motorfest for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
title: The Crew Motorfest - Official RC Frenzy Launch Trailer

description: The legendary Boomerang is the only fighter aircraft designed and manufactured in its entirety in Australia. Check out the latest Microsoft Flight Simulator trailer to see the Boomerang in action, available today (May 5, 2026) in the in-sim marketplace.

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the new Microsoft Flight Simulator trailer to see what to expect with the World Update 21: Australia, which brings a collection of missions for pilots to explore some of the iconic sites and locations of the country. The new trailer showcases a tour of gorgeous landscapes and areas in Australia, including the Twelve Apostles Visitor Amenities Building, Memorial Arc at Easter View, Melbourne, Sydney, and more.

Microsoft Flight Simulator World Update 21: Australia features several missions for both Microsoft Flight Simulator (2020) and Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

Microsoft Flight Simulator World Update 21: Australia is free to all owners of Microsoft Flight Simulator.
title: Microsoft Flight Simulator - Official World Update 21: Australia Trailer
